verdict.rationale: React's own docs explicitly recommend official full-stack meta-frameworks (Next.js, React Router) built on React for routing and data fetching, and describe server streaming and async server-side data fetching in frameworks implementing this pattern. Missing for 10: no independent hands-on corroboration of the recommended frameworks' routing/data-fetching workflow, and no first-party ownership detail (Next.js/React Router are third-party, not React-team-maintained).
